reasoning_type.description: The primary type of logical reasoning or analysis required by the user prompt. Categorized into classes such as comparative evaluation, causal troubleshooting, algorithmic calculation, factual retrieval, or creative generation.

input_context_specification.description: The format and structure of the input context provided in the user prompt. Categorized into classes such as self-contained direct questions, embedded code/text snippets, context-dependent follow-ups, or structured data inputs.

multi_turn_interaction_trajectory.description: The dominant interaction pattern observed across multiple turns of the dialogue. Categorized into classes such as single-turn, iterative refinement, conceptual clarification, error correction, or multi-step task progression.
